careme.note: Carême grouped the French sauces under four grandes sauces: espagnole, velouté, allemande and béchamel. Allemande is now taught as a daughter of velouté, and the five mothers of the modern kitchen, a scheme usually traced to Escoffier's Le Guide culinaire of 1903, add sauce tomate and hollandaise.
